column1: # Source-owned JWT compact-token/retry/load boundary for server-auth-token-boundary-wave.

column5: JwtCompactShape preserves the exact three-segment check; AuthTokenRetryState/AuthTokenCheck preserve initial-attempt plus retry ordering, reload-after-failure, and retry exhaustion; AuthTokenJwksState preserves missing-key and load-error outcomes without RSA/JWK verification, filesystem/network refresh, claims decoding, or authenticated-session publication.
